_doc: MAP-18 (docs/mapping-rules.md): the pinned forms of a provider's 'this key is not valid' answer that
arrive without HTTP 401. A provider error whose provider_code equals `code`, whose message satisfies
every text test given (`prefix`: starts with; `contains`: includes; `suffix`: ends with, all
case-sensitive) and, when the form gives `reason`, whose body carries that reason in a Google
is AuthError (auth). Checked before every other test, on every path that turns an HTTP reply into a
ProviderError. Ports carry this table as data, verbatim. A form is added only with a live receipt
and is never widened beyond the answer it was captured from. `providers` records where a form was
observed; matching does not use it.
